name: ThreatSwarm Pentest Engagement
description: Phases and tasks for a penetration testing engagement tracked in OpenProject

phases.name: 1. Scoping & Planning
phases.description: Define engagement scope, rules of engagement, and communication plan

tasks.subject: Define in-scope targets (IPs, domains, applications)
tasks.description: Create scope.txt with all authorized targets. Include IP ranges, CIDR blocks, domains, and specific applications.

tasks.subject: Define out-of-scope targets and rules of engagement
tasks.description: Document what is explicitly NOT in scope. Define testing windows, DoS policy, social engineering restrictions.

tasks.subject: Set up communication channels
tasks.description: Configure secure communication (encrypted email, Signal/Telegram). Establish POC escalation path.

tasks.subject: Initialize ThreatSwarm engagement workspace
tasks.description: Create evidence directory, initialize scope.txt, set up engagement metadata.

phases.name: 2. Reconnaissance
phases.description: Passive and active reconnaissance of in-scope targets

tasks.subject: Passive reconnaissance — OSINT
tasks.description: WHOIS, DNS enumeration, search engine dorking, social media profiling, subdomain discovery (subfinder, amass).

tasks.subject: Active scanning — port/service enumeration
tasks.description: Nmap full port scan, service version detection, OS fingerprinting. Identify attack surface.

tasks.subject: Web application mapping
tasks.description: Directory brute-forcing, technology fingerprinting, API endpoint discovery, sitemap extraction.

tasks.subject: Document all discovered assets
tasks.description: Update scope with discovered hosts/services. Create asset inventory in evidence directory.

tasks.subject: Automated vulnerability scanning
tasks.description: Run Nessus/Nuclei scans against discovered targets. Document all findings with evidence.

tasks.subject: Manual vulnerability testing
tasks.description: Manual testing of web apps, APIs, authentication mechanisms, authorization controls, business logic.

tasks.subject: Network vulnerability testing
tasks.description: Test network protocols, SMB, RDP, SSH, LDAP, DNS, SNMP for misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.

tasks.subject: Validate and triage all findings
tasks.description: Remove false positives, confirm exploitable findings, assign severity ratings (CVSS/CVSSv4).

phases.name: 4. Exploitation
phases.description: Verify impact of critical and high findings

tasks.subject: Exploit CRITICAL findings
tasks.description: Demonstrate impact of critical vulnerabilities. Capture evidence (screenshots, logs, POC).

tasks.subject: Exploit HIGH findings
tasks.description: Demonstrate impact of high-severity vulnerabilities. Document attack chain.

tasks.subject: Post-exploitation assessment
tasks.description: Assess lateral movement potential, privilege escalation, data exfiltration risk. Stay within scope.

tasks.subject: Verify evidence chain integrity
tasks.description: Run evidence_verify to confirm all screenshots and captures are intact and hash-verified.

tasks.subject: Generate technical report
tasks.description: Full technical report with all findings, steps to reproduce, evidence references, and remediation steps.

tasks.subject: Generate executive summary
tasks.description: High-level summary for management with risk overview, key findings, and prioritized recommendations.

tasks.subject: Generate compliance mapping (if applicable)
tasks.description: Map findings to PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other applicable frameworks.

tasks.subject: Final review and delivery
tasks.description: Internal review of report, client delivery via secure channel, evidence package export.

phases.name: 6. Debrief & Remediation Support
phases.description: Walk-through with client and remediation guidance

tasks.subject: Schedule and conduct findings debrief
tasks.description: Present findings to client stakeholders. Walk through attack chains and business impact.

tasks.subject: Provide remediation guidance
tasks.description: Detailed remediation steps for each finding. Prioritized by risk and effort.

tasks.subject: Plan re-test timeline
tasks.description: Agree on re-test window after client has implemented fixes. Update scope for re-test.

tasks.subject: Archive engagement and lessons learned
tasks.description: Archive evidence, update ThreatSwarm knowledge base, document lessons learned for future engagements.
